variants.title: Clippers and clampers with a germanium diode
variants.sample: Germanium point-contact diode, forward drop about 0.3 V
variants.unknown: the forward drop of a germanium diode
variants.note: A germanium diode starts to conduct at about 0.3 V, less than silicon. The 0.30 V is a typical textbook value (unsourced / illustrative).

source.title: Germanium diode forward drop about 0.3 V: typical textbook figure, not looked up

variants.title: Clippers and clampers with a Schottky diode
variants.sample: Schottky small-signal diode, forward drop about 0.25 V
variants.unknown: the forward drop of a Schottky diode
variants.note: A Schottky diode has a metal-semiconductor junction and conducts at a lower voltage than a p-n junction. The 0.25 V is illustrative (unsourced).

source.title: Schottky diode forward drop about 0.25 V at a few milliamps: illustrative, not looked up
